dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.context: Settings row label for height filter transport visibility mode.

dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.en: Controls how transport visibility is evaluated when filtering height layers.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.context: Settings row description for height filter transport visibility mode.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.de: Legt fest, wie die Sichtbarkeit von Transporten bei der Höhenfilterung bewertet wird.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.es: Controla cómo se evalúa la visibilidad de los transportes al filtrar las capas de altura.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.it: Controlla come viene valutata la visibilità dei trasporti durante il filtraggio dei livelli di altezza.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.pt: Controla como a visibilidade dos transportes é avaliada ao filtrar camadas de altura.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.ru: Управляет оценкой видимости транспортов при фильтрации слоёв высоты.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.zh: 控制按高度筛选时如何判断运输的可见性。
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.sv: Styr hur transportsynlighet utvärderas vid filtrering av höjdlager.

dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.context: Dropdown option for low height filter transport visibility.

dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.en: All inflection points of the transport must be at or below the threshold layer.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.context: Tooltip for Low transport visibility option.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.de: Alle Wendepunkte des Transports müssen auf oder unter der Schwellenebene liegen.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.es: Todos los puntos de inflexión del transporte deben estar en la capa umbral o por debajo.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.it: Tutti i punti di inflessione del trasporto devono trovarsi al livello soglia o al di sotto.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.pt: Todos os pontos de inflexão do transporte devem estar no nível de referência ou abaixo dele.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.ru: Все точки перегиба транспорта должны находиться на пороговом слое или ниже него.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.zh: 运输的所有转折点都必须位于阈值层或更低。
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.sv: Alla brytpunkter för transporten måste vara vid eller under tröskellagret.

dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.context: Dropdown option for medium height filter transport visibility.

dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.en: A majority of the inflection points of the transport must be at or below the threshold layer.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.context: Tooltip for Medium transport visibility option.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.de: Die Mehrheit der Wendepunkte des Transports muss auf oder unter der Schwellenebene liegen.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.es: La mayoría de los puntos de inflexión del transporte deben estar en la capa umbral o por debajo.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.it: La maggior parte dei punti di inflessione del trasporto deve trovarsi al livello soglia o al di sotto.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.pt: A maioria dos pontos de inflexão do transporte deve estar no nível de referência ou abaixo dele.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.ru: Большинство точек перегиба транспорта должны находиться на пороговом слое или ниже него.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.zh: 运输的大多数转折点必须位于阈值层或更低。
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.sv: En majoritet av transportens brytpunkter måste vara vid eller under tröskellagret.

dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.context: Dropdown option for high height filter transport visibility.

dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.en: At least one inflection point of the transport must be at or below the threshold layer.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.context: Tooltip for High transport visibility option.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.de: Mindestens ein Wendepunkt des Transports muss auf oder unter der Schwellenebene liegen.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.es: Al menos un punto de inflexión del transporte debe estar en la capa umbral o por debajo.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.it: Almeno un punto di inflessione del trasporto deve trovarsi al livello soglia o al di sotto.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.pt: Pelo menos um ponto de inflexão do transporte deve estar no nível de referência ou abaixo dele.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.ru: Хотя бы одна точка перегиба транспорта должна находиться на пороговом слое или ниже него.
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.zh: 运输至少有一个转折点位于阈值层或更低。
dtk.settings.height_filter_transport_vis.sv: Minst en brytpunkt för transporten måste vara vid eller under tröskellagret.

dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.en: Evaluates each pillar's height independently against the active layer.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.context: Tooltip for Detached pillar visibility option.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.de: Bewertet die Höhe jedes Pfeilers unabhängig von der aktiven Ebene.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.es: Evalúa la altura de cada pilar de forma independiente respecto a la capa activa.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.it: Valuta l'altezza di ogni pilastro indipendentemente dal livello attivo.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.pt: Avalia a altura de cada pilar independentemente do nível ativo.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.ru: Оценивает высоту каждого столба независимо от активного слоя.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.sv: Utvärderar varje pelares höjd självständigt mot det aktiva lagret.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.zh: 根据当前图层独立评估每根支柱的高度。

dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.en: Shows pillars whenever at least one visible transport or elevated structure is attached.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.context: Tooltip for Attached pillar visibility option.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.de: Zeigt Pfeiler an, sobald mindestens ein sichtbarer Transport oder eine erhöhte Struktur daran befestigt ist.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.es: Muestra los pilares cuando hay al menos un transporte visible o una estructura elevada conectados a ellos.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.it: Mostra i pilastri quando almeno un trasporto visibile o una struttura sopraelevata è collegato a essi.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.pt: Mostra os pilares sempre que pelo menos um transporte visível ou uma estrutura elevada estiver conectado a eles.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.ru: Показывает столбы, если к ним подключён хотя бы один видимый транспорт или надземная конструкция.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.sv: Visar pelare så länge minst en synlig transport eller upphöjd struktur är ansluten.
dtk.settings.height_filter_pillar_visibi.zh: 只要连接了至少一个可见运输或高架结构，就显示支柱。
